hints.title: Longest Common Substring Recurrence
hints.text: A repeated subarray is a contiguous common sequence. If nums1[i] == nums2[j], the matching length extends the match at (i-1, j-1).

hints.title: 2D State Grid Transition
hints.text: Let dp[i][j] be the length of the longest common suffix ending at nums1[i-1] and nums2[j-1]. If nums1[i-1] == nums2[j-1], dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1.

hints.title: Space-Optimized 1D Rolling Buffer
hints.text: Since dp[i][j] depends only on the previous row dp[i-1][j-1], iterate j backwards in a single 1D array of size len(nums2) + 1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N * M) time and O(M) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all pairs of start indices and scanning takes O(N * M * min(N, M)) cubic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Rolling 1D array space reduces auxiliary memory from O(N * M) down to O(M).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that a mismatch resets the subarray match length to zero.
